lines.en: A 52-card deck. Four seats. One queen to avoid.
lines.zh: 一副 52 张牌，四个座位，一张要躲开的皇后。

lines.en: Hearts. Pass three cards and take the trick.
lines.zh: 红心大战。传三张牌，收下每一墩。

lines.en: Left, right, across. Keep the dangerous cards moving.
lines.zh: 向左、向右、对家，把危险牌传出去。

lines.en: Follow suit. Every heart is a point, and so is the queen of spades.
lines.zh: 能跟就必须跟。每张红心一分，黑桃皇后十三分。

lines.en: Take all 26 points to shoot the moon and turn the table around.
lines.zh: 收下全部 26 分就是射月，整张牌桌都会翻转。

lines.en: Four computer levels, from a gentle companion to a counting challenge.
lines.zh: 四档电脑难度，从温和陪玩到会算牌的挑战。

lines.en: Four on one screen with a private curtain, or a phone joins over the local network.
lines.zh: 四人同屏有隐私幕帘，手机也能连局域网加入。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave, a family record, and no accounts.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存、家庭战绩，不用账号。
